text: The purpose of this report is to request the Board's approval to enter into a credit card agreement with Meridian Credit Union.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Referred the item back to the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live to modify the Credit Card agreement in accordance with the confidential instructions to staff attached to motion 1 by Paul Bernards at the TO Live Audit Committee meeting of November 15, 2019.
